Saving

Save at a quiet moment before moving on.

Use the game menu for saves and loads. Quick save and autosave keep separate recovery points.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Saving and loading games

You can save and load games at any time, using either the Quicksave feature or the Esc-menu.

For Quicksave use the <F5> key. The game will be saved as "QUICK SAVE".
For Quickload use the <F8> key. The game saved as "QUICK SAVE" will be loaded.

Using the "Save" and "Load" options in the Esc-menu, you can save games under any names you like.

Autosave

Every time you enter the Game zone or exit to the Global Map the game is saved automatically under the names "Autosave (when entering)" and "Autosave (when leaving)". You can change whether or not the game Autosaves in the Options menu.
